matches.description: Watch AZ Alkmaar vs Twente highlights and goals from Eredivisie on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 3, 2026. AZ Alkmaar and Twente faced off in a high-octane Eredivisie encounter that promised tactical intrigue and plenty of attacking intent. As both sides looked to solidify their standing in the league, the match unfolded into a rollercoaster of momentum shifts and individual brilliance. Early Advantage and Unfortunate Setbacks The match, held on May 3rd, 2026 , began with a surge of energy from the home side. AZ Alkmaar took the initiative early, looking to dominate possession and pin Twente back into their own half. The pressure paid off in the 13th minute when Jordy Clasie picked up the ball outside the penalty area and unleashed a powerful right-footed strike. The ball flew past the keeper to give AZ an early advantage, setting a frantic tempo for the opening period. However, the lead was erased in unfortunate circumstances just after the half-hour mark. In the 32nd minute, a defensive mishap saw goalkeeper Rome Owusu-Oduro inadvertently turn the ball into his own net, gifting Twente an equalizer and swinging the momentum toward the visitors before the halftime whistle. Twente Seize the Lead in the Second Half The second half saw Twente emerge with renewed confidence, exploiting the spaces left by an AZ side pushing to reclaim their lead. In the 55th minute, the turnaround was completed through a clinical attacking move. Kristian Hlynsson turned provider, finding Sam Lammers in a dangerous position; Lammers made no mistake, using his left foot to slot the ball home and put Twente in the driving seat. AZ manager responded with a series of tactical changes, introducing Peer Koopmeiners for the goalscorer Clasie in the 60th minute, followed later by Mexx Meerdink and Bendeguz Kovacs to inject fresh energy into the final third. Despite the changes, AZ struggled to find a way through a resolute Twente defense, with Troy Parrott missing several chances as the clock ticked toward the 90-minute mark. Stoppage-Time Redemption for the Hosts Just as it appeared that Twente would escape with all three points, the match delivered one final, heart-stopping twist deep into injury time. In the 95th minute, Rome Owusu-Oduro transitioned from villain to hero, providing a long-range assist that found Peer Koopmeiners . The substitute took aim from outside the box and struck a magnificent right-footed shot that beat the keeper, sparking wild celebrations in the stands. It was a moment of pure redemption for the young goalkeeper and a testament to AZ Alkmaar 's persistence. The referee blew the final whistle shortly after, concluding a thrilling 2-2 draw where neither side refused to back down until the very last second.

A Stunning Opening The contest began with an immediate burst of drama that left the home support in silence. Within the first minute of play, AZ Alkmaar capitalized on a defensive lapse from Gernot Trauner . Jordy Clasie provided the vision, finding Troy Parrott , who finished clinically with his right foot to give the visitors an early advantage. The goal set a frantic pace for the first half, as Feyenoord struggled to find their rhythm while AZ controlled 60% of the ball possession, frustrating the hosts with a disciplined defensive setup. Feyenoord's Resurgence Following the interval, the tactical landscape shifted as Feyenoord introduced fresh legs, including Tobias van den Elshout . The impact was almost immediate. In the 57th minute, a well-orchestrated move saw Van den Elshout provide the decisive assist for Anis Hadj Moussa . The attacker made no mistake, firing a left-footed strike into the net to restore parity. This goal breathed new life into the match, turning the second half into a tactical chess match where both sides searched for a winner under mounting pressure. High-Stakes Conclusion The final stages were marked by a series of tactical substitutions and defensive resilience. AZ Alkmaar pushed for a late decider, with Peer Koopmeiners forcing a save from Timon Wellenreuther in stoppage time. Despite the late pressure and several corners from Anis Hadj Moussa , neither side could find the definitive breakthrough. The referee eventually brought the intense encounter to a close after three minutes of added time, leaving both teams to reflect on a hard-earned point in a fixture defined by early errors and second-half recovery.
